name: Wo Yanzhong Suo Jian
source:
While attempting to stop the Martian invasion, "I" falls into the landing castle, where he encounters a “Martian” he once fought alongside. Just when he believes everything is still under control, a sinister shadow has already begun to close in around them.

Why did "I" fall into the landing castle? What lies behind the shadow?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5224490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
企图阻止火星人入侵的“我”坠入了扬陆城，在那里遇到了曾并肩作战的“火星人”。正当他以为一切仍在掌控之中时，一道诡异的黑影已悄然逼近两人周围。

“我”为何会坠入扬陆城？黑影背后究竟藏着什么？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5224490/]Steam[/url]]
